rationale: With only 1 minute remaining until market close, any position opened now would be immediately liquidated at the market, making meaningful profit capture impossible while still bearing full execution risk on both entry and forced exit. The stock has already fallen sharply from ~$15.78 to $13.08 today with no news context, and the last few candles show continued downward drift with no clear reversal signal. The risk/reward of a 1-minute forced liquidation trade is unfavorable regardless of direction.
